sentence_stem: I would love to come to your party, but
correct_completion: I have to work that evening.
full_sentence: I would love to come to your party, but I have to work that evening.
acceptable_variants: I have another commitment that night.
I am busy on Saturday evening.

options.text: I can come to your party.
options.why_wrong: This agrees to the invitation, so there is no contrast with the first part of the sentence, which 'but' requires.
This is a polite phrase, but it does not give the contrasting reason that 'but' expects.
This gives information about the party, but it does not explain why the speaker cannot come.

options.text: I have to work that evening.

explanation: After 'but', we need a clause that contrasts with the wish to attend. Learners sometimes repeat the wish again, but the sentence needs a barrier that prevents attending.
translation: Eu adoraria ir à sua festa, mas tenho que trabalhar naquela noite.
